title: Miami, Florida, USA — 1-Bed Apartment With Bay Views & Resort Pool
description:
High in a tower at the centre of Miami Worldcenter, this **one-bedroom residence** looks out across the bay through floor-to-ceiling glass. The layout is open and light all day, and the building does the rest — this is a home you arrive at with a suitcase and nothing else.

Downstairs, and it is a long way downstairs, sits **over 70,000 sq ft of amenities**: a **resort-style pool with private cabanas**, a **hammam spa** with sauna and steam rooms, yoga and fitness studios, and on-site fine dining. There is **beach club access on Miami Beach with a shuttle**, which is the piece most city apartments cannot offer. Downtown Miami, the Arsht Center and the Design District are all within a few minutes.

The residence is delivered newly finished and furnished by design partners featured in Architectural Digest, with furniture, lighting, appliances, linens and the rest included in the purchase price. **Short-term rentals are permitted here** — the operator runs the letting and you keep the income from the nights you do not use, which is rare in American co-ownership and worth more than it sounds.

Ownership here works a little differently: the home is divided into **eight shares**, and each one comes with **three fixed two-week stays a year** — one in the shoulder season, one in summer, one in winter — set when you buy rather than booked later. Because the dates are fixed, shares are priced by the weeks they carry. The price shown is the lowest of the eight; just ask and we'll send you the calendar and the price for each.
